title: H3 killed: no intraday momentum on MNQ
detail: 867 trades 2022-01 to 2025-06: net -4.12 pts per trade, t = -2.31 against the random-direction null; PF 0.78, -18.8%, DD 20%. Before costs the signal is -2.62 pts, t = -1.47 (not significant); the reversed signal nets +1.12 pts, t = +0.63. The significant negative result is costs on noise. Reversal is NOT adopted: flipping a signal after seeing the result would be data mining.
